title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description:
Count the contiguous subarrays whose elements add up to exactly k. The array can contain negative numbers and zeros.

Input format
Line 1: n and k separated by a space.
Line 2: n integers.

Output format
One integer: the number of contiguous subarrays with sum k.
hints: A subarray sum can be written as the difference of two prefix sums. Which pairs of prefix sums differ by k?
While scanning, keep a dictionary of how many times each prefix sum has appeared so far. For the current prefix sum P, add count[P - k] to the answer.
Start the dictionary with {0: 1} so subarrays beginning at index 0 are counted. A sliding window does not work because negative numbers break its monotonic behaviour.

examples.explanation: The subarrays [1,1] at positions 0-1 and 1-2 both sum to 2.
Seven subarrays add up to 0, for example [1,-1], [0] and [-1,0,1].
